parts:
Here are **great Christmas gift ideas** for your boyfriend that match his interests — bik­ing, real estate, heavy machinery, riding, farm life, clothing, and gear. I grouped them by category so your mom and dad can pick based on **budget and personality**:

---

## 🚵‍♂️ **For the Rider / BMX + Mountain Bike Fan**
🎁 **High-quality BMX/MTB Gloves** — Durable for trail and park riding.  
🎁 **Tool Kit for Bikes** — Compact multitool with bike-specific bits.  
🎁 **Protective Gear Upgrade** — Knee/elbow pads or a lightweight trail helmet.  
🎁 **Bike Maintenance Stand** — Keep his ride spotless & tuned.  
🎁 **Action Camera Mount** — For GoPro/phone footage of trails.

---

## 🛠️ **For the Heavy Machinery / Real Estate / Farm Guy**
🎁 **Heavy-Duty Work Gloves** — Comfortable and rugged for machinery/farm work.  
🎁 **Insulated Work Jacket or Vest** — Great for cold mornings on the farm.  
🎁 **Hydraulic or Tool Set Organizers** — Keeps tools orderly in truck or barn.  
🎁 **Custom Farm Sign** — His name or farm logo wood/metal sign.  
🎁 **Heavy-Duty Boot Gift Card** — Let him pick what fits his work style.

---

## 👕 **Clothing & Everyday Gear**
🎁 **Puma Apparel Set** — Hoodie + tee + hat (his size & favorite colors).  
🎁 **Performance Socks / Shoe Gift Card** — Great for riding or hanging out.  
🎁 **Sponsored Clothing Box** — If you know brands he loves, a curated box could kill.

---

## 🔫 **For the Gun Enthusiast (if appropriate & safe)**
> *Make sure it fits their household rules and local laws.*

🎁 **Range Bag** — Tough, organized, perfect for gear and ammo.  
🎁 **Quality Ear/ Eye Protection** — Comfortable for long range sessions.  
🎁 **Cleaning Kit** — Premium and comprehensive set.  
🎁 **Gift Certificate to Local Shooting Range** — For practice and fun.

---

## 🎥 **Tech & Fun Experience Gifts**
🎁 **GoPro or Action Camera Accessories** — Chest mount, helmet mount, extra batteries.  
🎁 **Drone with Camera** — For aerial shots of trails/farm.  
🎁 **Adventure Experience** — Single-day guided mountain biking trip or farm workshop.  
🎁 **Real Estate Book / Audio Book Subscription** — For business & mindset growth.

---

## 🧑‍🌾 **Farm / Workshop Projects**
🎁 **Engraved Multi-Tool or Pocket Knife** — Practical and sentimental.  
🎁 **Custom Leather Tool Belt or Apron** — Personalized and durable.  
🎁 **Steel Fire Pit Kit** — Great for evenings with friends.

---

## 🏷️ **Great All-Around Gift Combos**
✨ **“Lifestyle Pack”**:  
- Performance hoodie (Puma)  
- Bike multitool + gloves  
- Range bag accessory  
- High-end socks

✨ **“Workshop Starter”**:  
- Insulated work jacket  
- Tool organizers  
- Personalized farm sign

✨ **“Adventure Pack”**:  
- Action camera accessories  
- Trail helmet upgrade  
- Day pass to a local trail/event

---

## 💡 Gift Budget Quick Picks

| Budget | Gift Ideas |
|--------|------------|
| **Under $50** | Bike gloves, socks, small multitool, range accessories |
| **$50–$150** | Puma gear, tool organizers, bike maintenance tools |
| **$150–$300** | Action cam accessories, insulated jacket, range bag |
| **$300+** | GoPro, drone, guided adventure experience |

---

## 🎄 Bonus Tips
✅ Ask him MOST SUBTLY what he needs or wants (casual “Oh hey what tool do you use most?”)  
✅ Get a small **personal note** from your parents — it makes any gift feel custom.  
✅ Combine **practical + fun** (e.g., gloves + experience ticket).

---

If you want, tell me **their gift budget**, and I’ll build a **perfect gift list they can pick from** with exact products!
